topic: Demographic data model adjustments and issues
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered several technical points regarding data synchronization and demographic modeling. Initially, adjustments were made to the real-time sync process, including limiting operation hours (8 AM to 10 PM) and modifying conditions to handle potential date boundary skips.

A major topic was the handling of demographic data for virtual sensors versus physical locations. It was noted that while a new model uses regional demographics, some virtual locations require static or specific demographics. A proposed solution involved checking if explicit facility-level data exists within the query, overriding the standard calculation based on `area_of_living`.

Concerns were raised about the completeness of available demographic variables (e.g., needing income data when only gender and age are provided) and the complexity of implementing a fully balanced model. The team discussed returning to an older view (`v_ch_demographic`) that was previously used for regional demographics, suggesting it might be possible to integrate this into the current system.
decisions: Implement logic to check for explicit facility-level demographic data in queries, overriding area-based calculations for virtual sensors.
action_items: Investigate feasibility of reintroducing the older regional demographic view (`v_ch_demographic`).
Address the requirement for additional variables (like income) beyond current gender and age data.
